text:
elaine: Heads up — saw a client hit where pin TTL cleaned up before their probe backfilled a lease. Thinking we need ordered GC + probe hinting. Anyone seen similar?

ryan: Yep saw one yesterday on staging. Sequence was: client creates rollout -> probe delayed -> GC ran -> model evicted -> requests 503. Short-term fix: extend soft-ttl by 30s.

sophie: Extending TTL bandaid seems risky. Suggest we encode probe intent in rollout metadata: `probe_pending: true`, and GC should ignore if present + recent `probe_ts`.

santhosh: Agree. But that adds schema field. Need to consider cross-version compatibility for clients that don't set it. Maybe interpret absence as no probe.

tessa: Also edge: multi-tenant pin merges where two tenants race to pin same model with different probe hints. GC needs per-tenant provenance, not just a global flag.

infra-bot: ops-bot:gc_manager noticed eviction on model:open-v2@hash at 2026-03-22T11:12:03Z - reason: ttl_expired

ryan: What if instead GC uses a two-phase: mark-for-evict (quarantine) + finalize after grace window if no renewed lease? Clients can touch the quarantine token to keep.

kyle: Implementation idea: metadata fields: `quarantine_until`, `probe_accepts_quarantine_touch` and client API `touch_quarantine(model_id)`. Fallback: if client can't touch, then we rely on longer soft TTL.

elaine: We should minimize schema churn. Maybe add `retain_hints: ["probe", "staging"]` as an extensible list. GC looks for any retained hint recently refreshed.

santhosh: Extensible list is nice. Need to document semantics vs `pin_owner` and `pin_epoch`. Also ensure routing logic doesn't treat retained as permanent residency for cost reasons.

sophie: Agree on docs. Also UX: Console should show `retained_by: probe (last_seen 11:10)`. Observability need.

elaine: Action items: ryan to prototype quarantine flow, sophie to draft schema minimal add (`retain_hints`), tessa to list multi-tenant merging cases, I'll sync with PLG on console labels. Back in 48h?

ryan: :thumbsup: will spike this on staging. I'll drop a short RFC in #architecture when done.
